title: 第十七章 击杀两人第十八章 突破炼体二层
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
进入院子后，林枫揭开黄油布，瞬间一头体型硕大的黑熊映入眼帘。
3米多高，估摸着体重最少600kg左右。
还头一次看到这么大的熊，林枫忍不住惊呼一声。
接着林枫摸了摸熊掌，用自己的手和这熊比划了一下，大小差距3倍左右
“二牛，这么大的家伙都能猎杀，关键你能将它拉到城里，真牛逼”
赵二牛倒没觉得什么：“还好，不怎么吃力”
林枫竖起了大拇指，只能心里说牛逼。
“打算卖多少钱？”
赵二牛：“这熊已经接近妖兽了，140两如何？”
林枫：“好，成交”
在牛马市场这对熊掌可是极品熊掌，光是四个熊掌就能卖50两。
还不算熊胆、熊皮、熊肉、熊骨等等，140两要价并不高。
因此林枫也没还价，爽快的给了140两。
看到林枫给的现银，赵二牛憨厚一笑，“还是林公子爽快”
交易完成，赵二牛两只手提起黑熊，将其放到了院子里。
如此轻松的样子，看的林枫一阵羡慕，天生神力就是牛逼。
交易完成，赵二牛对着林枫拱手抱拳道：“林公子再会”
“再会，有好东西记得来找我”
“没问题”
突然，砰一声巨响，街门被踹飞出去。

一高一矮两个男子映入眼帘。
林枫望着两人身上的黑色劲服，一眼就认出两人是田家武馆的弟子。
两人看着院子的这头巨熊，顿时露出满意的笑容。
走进院子，高个子的男子冷笑道：
“终于逮到你俩了”
“整个永关县的药材和兽皮交易市场，都是我们田家武馆在控制。
买卖都要收费。
竟然敢背着我们私下交易。
真当田家武馆是吃素的？”
见状，林枫不想闹太僵，而是说道：“这个我们真不知道，现在怎么处理？”
“哼，怎么处理？这黑熊就是罚款，还有黑熊卖的银子也交出来。
另外，你们这已经不是第一次交易了。
你们两个，每人再额外交300两的罚款”
真黑啊。
林枫：“真没这么多银子，能不能给个机会？”
content_en:
After entering the yard, Lin Feng opened the butter cloth and instantly saw a huge black bear.
He is over 3 meters tall and his weight is estimated to be at least 600kg.
Seeing such a big bear for the first time, Lin Feng couldn't help but exclaimed.
Then Lin Feng touched the bear's paw and gestured with the bear with his own hand. The difference in size was about 3 times.
"Er Niu, you can hunt such a big guy. The key is that you can pull it into the city. It's really awesome."
Zhao Erniu didn't feel anything at all: "It's okay, it's not very strenuous."
Lin Feng gave a thumbs up and could only say in his heart that he was awesome.
"How much do you plan to sell it for?"
Zhao Erniu: "This bear is already close to a monster. How about 140 taels?"
Lin Feng: "Okay, deal"
In the cattle and horse market, these bear paws are the best. Just four bear paws can be sold for 50 taels.
Not counting bear bile, bear skin, bear meat, bear bones, etc., the asking price of 140 taels is not high.
Therefore, Lin Feng did not counter-offer and readily gave 140 taels.
Seeing the cash given by Lin Feng, Zhao Erniu smiled honestly, "Master Lin is still happy."
After the transaction was completed, Zhao Erniu picked up the black bear with both hands and placed it in the yard.
Seeing such a relaxed look made Lin Feng feel envious. He was born with incredible powers.
After the transaction was completed, Zhao Erniu raised his hands to Lin Feng and said, "Goodbye, Mr. Lin."
"Goodbye, remember to come to me if you have any good things."
“No problem”
Suddenly, there was a loud bang and the street door was kicked out.
Two men, one tall and one short, came into view.
Lin Feng looked at the black clothes on the two men and recognized them at a glance as disciples of the Tian Family Martial Arts School.
The two of them looked at the giant bear in the yard and immediately smiled with satisfaction.
Walking into the courtyard, the tall man sneered:
"Finally caught you two"
“The entire medicinal materials and animal skin trading market in Yongguan County is controlled by our Tianjia Martial Arts School.
There are fees for buying and selling.
How dare you do private transactions behind our backs.
Do you really think Tianjia Martial Arts School is vegetarian? "
Seeing this, Lin Feng didn't want to cause too much trouble, but said: "We really don't know this, how should we deal with it now?"
"Hmph, how to deal with it? This black bear is fined, and the money from the black bear's sale is also handed over.
In addition, this is not your first transaction.
You two will each pay an additional fine of 300 taels."
So dark.
Lin Feng: "I really don't have that much money, can you give me a chance?"
